references.text: Joseph explains that what people intended for evil, God used for good—the same principle of God's sovereign guidance through human actions
Man plans his way, but the Lord directs his steps—God's sovereign control over human decisions
The king's heart is like streams of water in the Lord's hand; he turns it wherever he wills—God's sovereign control over human choices
Assyria is used as God's instrument without knowing it—God uses human actions for his purposes without their knowledge
The Lord raised up judges for Israel—the context of Philistine domination over Israel during the period of the judges
Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight, and the Lord gave them into the hand of the Philistines for forty years—the background to Philistine rule
Jesus was handed over according to God's set plan and foreknowledge—God's sovereign plan works through human actions
All things work together for good for those who love God—God's sovereign guidance of all circumstances
